<quote by="Proposed: Semmerholm, Seconded: Karov">To construct the Journeymage Towers in Lacre, Malimorzi and Bittershore. Call for a dispersal of funds</quote>
==Overview==
* Constructs a series of [[folly|follies]] in Semmerholm, Ossium, and Karov to remove the threat to ships posed by [[Dho'uala]] as per the '''[[Less_welcome_tenants#Wards_and_Bargains|Less welcome tenants]]''' wind of fortune
* Passed
* 60 Thrones disbursed to the [[Senator]] for [[Semmerholm]]
* This motion received the support of the Wisdom Assembly through a [[386YE_Summer_Solstice_Synod_judgements#Judgement_58|mandate]] enacted by '''Kalina Jadwigowna Piosnkowa Prochnost'''

==Date==
* Summer 386YE
==Cost==
* Costs as per opportunity
* 24 white granite
* 72 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Journeymage_Towers}}
==Outcome==
Now complete, the threat to the ships on the Semmerlak has been resolved. The ''Wavewatchers'' sodality has been firmly established. The Imperial Senate passed a [[386YE_Autumn_Equinox_Senate_sessions#Create_title_of_Watcher_of_the_Semmerlak|motion]] to create the title of [[Watcher of the Semmerlak]] during the Autumn Equinox 386YE.
